name: nestjs-openapi-generation-benchmark
description: Benchmark of the OpenAPI and AsyncAPI generators for NestJS on an Algoan-like codebase

scripts.setup: npm --prefix bench install && npm --prefix app install && node bench/src/cli.ts install && npm run setup:nestoa-main && npm run setup:nestoa-asyncapi
scripts.setup:nestoa-main: if command -v cargo >/dev/null; then bench/scripts/build-nestoa-main.sh; else echo 'cargo not found: nestoa-main is not built (install Rust, then run npm run setup:nestoa-main)' >&2; fi
scripts.setup:nestoa-asyncapi: if command -v cargo >/dev/null; then NESTOA_REF=f79b1a060e5fbdefd0f3751dae268a6acd91f656 NESTOA_BIN=nestoa-asyncapi bench/scripts/build-nestoa-main.sh; else echo 'cargo not found: nestoa-asyncapi is not built (install Rust, then run npm run setup:nestoa-asyncapi)' >&2; fi
